text: First of all, at this first step, will be to perform anti-scanning, but in a very particular way. That is, you will solicit access point to reply, but not by sending a broadcast solicitation. So you will not just say, "Who is there?" You actually press me a packet that says, "Are you my owner access point there?" That is the most frequently access point you can have to. Okay, so for example, my apartment access point is called Black and White because in Turin we have the Juventus football team and my husband is a supporter of the football team of Juventus and the colors of Juventus are black and white. So our access point is called Black and White. So my phone, when I turn the Wi-Fi interface on, or what it does is to send a message here at this step saying, "Are you Black and White access point there?" That's what it will say. If I'm home, I will immediately receive the answer from my home access point saying, "Yes, I'm here," right? And let's see, we are done. If I am at the university, my Wi-Fi card probably will still say, as I turn on my Wi-Fi interface, "Are you Black and White."
